description.value: Mr. Falafel is a family-owned Mediterranean grill that has anchored Vancouver's west side since 2002, serving falafel wraps, shawarma, souvlaki skewers, kibbeh, and house-made dolmades made with locally-sourced ingredients. The casual counter-service format makes it a quick and filling stop for cyclists passing through the Kitsilano area. Both dine-in and takeout are available, with online ordering for pickup.
